data: © NASA/U. Colorado/LASP — Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN; studies how Mars lost its atmosphere to space.

Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN. Quantified the rate at which Mars loses atmosphere to space — about 100 g/s of oxygen and CO₂ stripped by the solar wind. Showed that Mars's atmospheric thinning was driven by the loss of its global magnetic field ~4 billion years ago.
First mission dedicated to atmospheric escape; explained how Mars lost its early atmosphere.
First mission dedicated to studying how Mars lost its atmosphere
